method: every page image read by a reviewing agent and compared item by item with the reader's output (spike/valve_visual_pack.py); every suspected error confirmed against the PDF text layer before it counts; round 2 re-judged every line the fixed reader changed

round2_after_fixes.left: two datasheets' sheet 2 print a cut-off Document No. (drawing typo) — the reader keeps sheet 1's number and the tool now raises it as a Data Error

causes_fixed: text hidden under a later white fill (Excel drop-down remnants, overprinted sheet numbers) — judged from drawing order
duplicate overprinted words ('NA' over 'NA') read twice
3-pt line bucket split one line (a two-part value came out reversed)
page footer 'Page N of M' glued to the last note — notes bounded by the notes frame
Form 102 single-column sheet sent to the On/Off reader; right-hand 'Label : value' beside rows 1-4 dropped
'3. ATTACHMENT' swallowed by the last General Note
'HOLD:' list merged into the last note
